dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 29, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MARLINS SWEEP PHILLIES, GIANTS SHUT DOWN BREWERS IN BIG WINS**

The Miami Marlins took down the Philadelphia Phillies 8-6 behind a strong staff effort. Griffin Conine homered for the second time this season, driving in two runs. The Arizona Diamondbacks also earned a big win, shutting out the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-0. Gabriel Moreno and Eduardo Rodriguez led the way for Arizona, with Moreno homering and Rodriguez tossing 8 strong innings. In other games, the San Francisco Giants pounded the Milwaukee Brewers 16-3, while the Los Angeles Dodgers edged the Seattle Mariners 4-2. The Tampa Bay Rays also won, taking down the Texas Rangers 3-0 behind MacKenzie Gore's 9 strikeouts in 7 innings.
